manifest_and_oof_reconciliation.failure_reasons: Monsoon 100% cloud cover over growing windows (2 Chillies, 1 Maize, 1 Paddy)
manifest_and_oof_reconciliation.farm_id_alignment: 100% agreement across manifest, clean features, and OOF predictions

daily_mosaicking_architecture.mechanism: Extracts unique acquisition dates from collection, mosaics scenes acquired on the same date (overlapping MGRS tiles) before temporal median reduction.
daily_mosaicking_architecture.cloud_shadow_masking: Applied via SCL (Scene Classification Layer) masking classes 3 (shadow), 8 (cloud med), 9 (cloud high), 10 (cirrus), 11 (snow). Mosaicking allows clear pixels from overlapping swaths on the same date to shine through.
daily_mosaicking_architecture.missing_value_handling: Windows with zero unmasked pixels evaluate to np.nan (never 0.0), preserving radiometric integrity and preventing fabricated zeros.
daily_mosaicking_architecture.configuration: Added daily_mosaic=True parameter to extract_zonal_stats_for_farm and BatchSentinelExtractor.

satellite_only_track.features: 14 spectral indices x 4 phenological windows (56) + 4 multi-temporal dynamic deltas (ndvi_growth_delta, peak_to_early_ratio, ndvi_senescence_delta, moisture_loss_delta)
satellite_only_track.leakage_audit: Strictly excludes all ground truth calendar dates, duration, season, and spatial coordinates.

retrospective_vs_operational_boundary.retrospective_classification: Post-harvest census / subsidy audit where full growing season and harvest dates are known. Uses all 4 windows + duration_days + harvest_month/doy.
retrospective_vs_operational_boundary.operational_early_season_prediction: In-season crop identification during vegetative stage. Strictly forbids harvest dates (HDate, harvest_month, harvest_doy, duration_days) and mid/late season indices as target leakage. Uses only sowing calendar + early phenological window + farm geometry.

extraction_workload_and_safeguards.resume_behavior: Skips existing success status; retries failed records
extraction_workload_and_safeguards.phase6c_preservation: Phase 6C artifacts (s2_phase6c_350_*) remain 100% untouched and unoverwritten.
